common.tagline: Short links you stay in control of.
common.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.resetDone: Your password was changed. Please sign in again.

register.title: Create your account
register.sentBody: If this address can be used, we have sent an email with the next step. The link is valid for 24 hours.

verify.title: Email verification
verify.done: Your email is verified. You can now create links.
verify.invalid: This link is invalid, expired or was already used.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If this address has an account, we have sent a reset link. It is valid for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.noToken: This page needs the link from the reset email.

dashboard.title: Your links
dashboard.unverifiedBody: We sent a link to {email}. You can create links once your address is verified.

errors.invalid_email: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.weak_password.TOO_SHORT: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
errors.weak_password.TOO_LONG: The password must be at most 128 characters long.
errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid, expired or was already used.
errors.too_many_emails: We sent an email moments ago. Please wait a minute before asking again.
errors.email_not_verified: Verify your email address to create links.
errors.invalid_target.ILLEGAL_CHARACTER: The address contains a character that is not allowed.
errors.invalid_target.MALFORMED: This is not a valid web address.
errors.invalid_target.UNSUPPORTED_SCHEME: The address must start with http:// or https://.
errors.invalid_target.CREDENTIALS: Addresses with a user name or password are not accepted.
errors.invalid_target.IP_ADDRESS: Use a domain name instead of an IP address.
errors.invalid_target.INVALID_HOST: The domain name is not valid.
errors.invalid_target.NON_DEFAULT_PORT: Addresses with a custom port are not accepted.
errors.invalid_target.SELF_REFERENCE: A Vurli link cannot point to another Vurli link.
errors.invalid_alias: This custom name cannot be used.
errors.invalid_alias.FORMAT: A custom name has 3–50 characters: letters, digits and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen.
errors.invalid_alias.RESERVED: This name is reserved. Pick another one.
errors.invalid_expiry: The expiry must be in the future.
errors.alias_taken: This name is already taken. Try another one.
errors.version_conflict: The link changed somewhere else in the meantime. The current version is shown below; try again if needed.
errors.link_blocked: This link is blocked and cannot be changed.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.link_quota_exceeded: You reached the number of links you can create in 24 hours. Try again later.
errors.unsafe_target: This address is on a list of dangerous sites (phishing or malware). A link to it cannot be created.

links.aliasHint: Letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. cafe-menu.
links.unverified: Verify your email address to create links.
links.empty: No links yet. Create your first one above.

link.createdNotice: Your link is ready. Copy it or download its QR code.
link.qrHint: The QR code carries the short link, so printed codes keep working when you change the destination.
link.expiryHint: Leave it empty and the link never expires.
link.disabledHint: A link that is off tells visitors it is no longer in use.
link.blockedHint: This link was blocked for abuse. You can only delete it.
link.deleteHint: A deleted link stops working and its name is never given to anyone else.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.empty: No clicks in the last 30 days. Bots and link previews are not counted.
stats.note: Days are UTC. Statistics are approximate; bots and link previews are not counted.
